name: Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low Golf 'Neutral Olive'
story_html: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low Golf ‘Neutral Olive’ updates the iconic silhouette with a retooled construction made for the golf course. A reverse black leather Swoosh highlights the lateral side of the upper, featuring an olive nubuck base with off-white leather overlays at the forefoot and heel. A woven Jordan Golf tag stands out on the tongue in a lime green hue, matching the Cactus Jack and Jordan Wings logos that adorn the back tab of the left and right shoe. Underfoot, the rubber cupsole features an integrated traction pattern for superior grip.
